curationNotes: Startup Gmail signature preflight passed. Working tree had unstaged previous-batch offer edits only, with no overlap in this batch's paths. Curated from live indexed Wix small-business pages in the 2026-05-15 2:00 AM run. Inspected 15 live candidate pages with Playwright, selected 10 because each has usable email contact, local-service intent, source assets, and visible conversion cleanup needs. Duplicates from previous batches were excluded before selection, and candidates with signs of a newer independent domain were not selected. Prototypes must be GPT-5.5-authored one site per isolated sub-agent, no old scripted prototype generator.

items.name: Home and Beyond Cleaning Services, LLC
items.vertical: residential, commercial, make-ready, construction, vacation-rental, office, gym, and window cleaning
items.summary: Wix cleaning site has a strong founder story, insured language, service breadth, email, phone, quote form, and many cleaning images, but the first screen leads with a generic slogan and the quote path sits below a long story and service list.
items.angle: Keep the friendly white-and-blue Wix cleaning feel while moving insured proof, service categories, and a clear walk-through quote CTA closer to the first screen

items.name: Serio Home Services LLC
items.vertical: handyman, drywall repair, home repair, maintenance, TV mounting, and shelving
items.summary: Owner-led handyman Wix site has clear phone/email actions, service sections, and home-repair imagery, but the page repeats calls to action without enough local trust, job examples, or scan-friendly estimate flow.
items.angle: Preserve the simple handyman-contractor layout while turning the first screen into a stronger free-estimate path with service cards, trust cues, and phone/email CTAs

items.name: Griff's Cleaning and Covid Disinfecting Services LLC
items.vertical: carpet, upholstery, home, commercial, floor, tile, grout, disinfecting, and exterior cleaning
items.summary: Griff's has authentic photos, a memorable cleaning-product story, email, phone, quote form, and broad service coverage, but the homepage is crowded, repetitive, and makes visitors parse too much before contacting.
items.angle: Keep the authentic real-photo cleaning identity while organizing carpet, floors, disinfecting, and home or commercial cleaning into a clearer quote-focused flow

items.name: Christelle Cleaning Services LLC
items.vertical: office cleaning, house cleaning, and move-in or move-out cleaning
items.summary: Christelle's Wix site has online booking, pricing ranges, a contact form, email, two phone numbers, and a Marshfield address, but it still feels like a default service template with thin proof and buried local trust.
items.angle: Keep the clean blue-and-white service template but make office, house, and move-out cleaning packages clearer with local proof, booking CTA, and sharper trust language

items.name: Quick N’ Go Mobile Detail LLC
items.vertical: mobile auto detailing, vinyl wraps, and paint protection film
items.summary: Quick N' Go has package pricing, service photos, an address, email, phone, and a memorable brand voice, but the package page does not quickly explain why to choose them or how to request the right detail package.
items.angle: Preserve the energetic mobile-detailing look while turning the package list into an easier choose-your-detail path with proof, add-ons, and quote/contact CTAs

items.name: Bad grASS Lawn Care LLC
items.vertical: lawn mowing, edging, trimming, hedges, blowing, irrigation repair, mulch, and outdoor maintenance
items.summary: Bad grASS has a memorable name, phone, email, discount offer, local lawn-service intent, and a compact service list, but the page is very thin and needs stronger first-screen trust and estimate framing.
items.angle: Keep the bold green lawn-care personality while adding a clearer free-consultation hero, service grid, seasonal proof, and fast quote/contact route

items.name: Green Queen Eco Clean LLC
items.vertical: eco-friendly house cleaning, move-in or move-out cleaning, carpet shampooing, stain removal, and upholstery cleaning
items.summary: Green Queen has a clear eco-friendly cleaning angle, email, phone, quote form, original logo/photo assets, and specialty carpet services, but the copy is hard to scan and the top of page underuses the natural-products differentiator.
items.angle: Preserve the green eco-cleaning identity while making natural products, carpet specialties, cleaning frequency, and quote CTA visible before the long background copy

items.name: Industry Pros Pressure Washing LLC
items.vertical: deck power washing, soft house washing, driveway cleaning, vehicle washing, and exterior pressure washing
items.summary: Industry Pros has phone, email, address, hours, bookable services, quote form, and multiple pressure-washing images, but the site has template remnants, awkward pricing copy, and a fragmented contact path.
items.angle: Keep the blue pressure-washing service look while cleaning up template remnants, surfacing Charlotte contact details, grouping services, and strengthening the quote path

items.name: Amro LLC Lawncare/Landscaping Services
items.location: Des Moines, IA and surrounding areas
items.vertical: lawn care, landscaping, retaining walls, spring cleaning, fall cleaning, residential, and commercial outdoor services
items.summary: Amro's Wix site has Des Moines service-area language, free estimates, lawn and landscaping categories, email, phone, and outdoor images, but the homepage title and first screen do not communicate the strongest local estimate path fast enough.
items.angle: Preserve the residential and commercial landscaping feel while clarifying Des Moines service areas, free-estimate CTA, core lawn services, and seasonal cleanup proof

items.name: Abene Property LLC
items.location: NW Chicago, Park Ridge, Des Plaines, Niles, IL
items.vertical: landscape, lawn, snow removal, and year-round outdoor property maintenance
items.summary: Abene has a logo, email, phone, local suburb coverage, year-round maintenance positioning, and service depth, but the page hides most service proof in dense copy and needs a cleaner estimate-first structure.
items.angle: Keep the local NW Chicago landscaping identity while moving year-round maintenance, suburb coverage, services, and free-estimate CTA into a more persuasive first-screen flow
